newsitem.title: FRANCE: United Airlines to join Traxon in Asia.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines to join Traxon in Asia.

text.p: United Airlines is on the point of joining airfreight information system, Traxon, a Traxon Europe official told Reuters.
"UAL is likely to sign up this coming weekend, initially limiting its sphere of operation, via Traxon, to Asia," the official said.
UAL would be the third U.S. carrier to join Traxon following Northwest at the end of 1996 and Federal Express at the beginning of 1997, both of which use Traxon in Asia, the official added..
"Two other airlines, Austrian Airlines and Air Malta are on the point of joining Traxon while Air India is also showing an interest."

Traxon's services include the provision of information on flights schedules, booking of shipments and tracing and tracking of shipments, reservation and transmission of air waybill information to airlines.

The list of Traxon's airline participants "worldwide" reads: Air Canada, Air France, British Airways, Cargolux, Cathay Pacific, Emirates, Finnair, Japan Airlines, KLM, Korean Airlines, Lufthansa, Martinair, Royal Air Maroc, SAS, Singapore Airlines and Swissair.
Traxon has 1,879 agents worldwide covering a network of 4,836 offices. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
